description.value:
You have learned arcane plans that you use to make magic items.

Plans Known. When you gain this feature, choose four plans from the Magic Item Plans (Artificer Level 2+) table; Bag of Holding, Cap of Water Breathing, Sending Stones, and Wand of the War Mage are recommended. Whenever you gain an Artificer level, you can replace one plan you know with a new one for which you qualify. You learn more plans at certain Artificer levels, as shown in the Plans Known column of the Artificer Features table, chosen from any Magic Item Plans table for which your Artificer level qualifies you.

Creating an Item. When you finish a Long Rest, you can create one or two different magic items if you have Tinker's Tools in hand, each based on a plan you know. If an item requires Attunement, you can attune to it the instant you create it, or later through the normal process. At certain Artificer levels, the number of items you can create at the end of a Long Rest increases, as shown in the Magic Items column; each item must be based on a different plan. You can't have more items from this feature than that column shows: if you would exceed it, the oldest item vanishes and the new one appears.

Duration. An item created by this feature works like the normal magic item, but its magic isn't permanent: when you die, it vanishes after 1d4 days. If you replace a plan, any item created from it immediately vanishes. If a vanishing item is a container, such as a Bag of Holding, its contents harmlessly appear in and around its space.

Spellcasting Focus. You can use any Wand or Weapon created by this feature as a Spellcasting Focus instead of Artisan's Tools.
